record.dic_text:
06741 Tsillah {tsil-law'}

源自 06738; 陰性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Zillah 3; 3

洗拉 = "蔭影"
1) 拉麥的第二個妻子, 土八該隱的母親；土八該隱是銅匠鐵匠的祖師
record.edic_text:
06741 Tsillah {tsil-law'}

from 06738;; n pr f

AV - Zillah 3; 3

Zillah = "shade"
1) the 2nd wife of Lamech and mother of Tubal-cain, an instructor of
   every craftsman in bronze and iron
